title: Reciprocal two-cup air relay
summary: A ball is thrown high into the air when the episode starts and comes down near the left Panda. The left arm catches it in its cup and throws it through the air to the right arm, whose cup must have moved from its start to catch it. The right arm carries the ball to a second transfer region and throws it back. The left arm catches it again and delivers it into an open box that slides back and forth along a rail, where the ball must settle while the box is moving.
robot_setup: Two Pandas. panda-0 (left): base at (-0.55, -0.22, 0), yaw 0 (facing +x). panda-1 (right): base at (0.74, 0.22, 0), yaw pi (facing -x). Each hand carries a closed square cup: 0.12 m x 0.12 m inside (2 x `tool_half`), walls 28 mm high (`tool_height`) and 5 mm thick, floor 5 mm thick. The tool frame is the centre of the floor's top surface, z up out of the cup. A fixed adapter bar joins the cup's -x wall (tool frame) to the hand; in the tool frame the hand's TCP is at (-0.12, 0, +0.04). At the start the left cup is level with identity orientation, centre at (0.02, -0.18, 0.22). The right cup is level and turned 180 deg about z (orientation wxyz (0, 0, 0, 1), so its adapter side faces +x, towards its own base), centre at (0.19, 0.18, 0.22). Role labels by phase (panda-0, panda-1): left_initial_catch (catcher, preparing_receiver); left_to_right_flight (donor, moving_receiver); right_catch (clearing_donor, catcher); second_region (preparing_receiver, loaded_carrier); right_to_left_flight (moving_receiver, donor); left_catch_and_deliver (catcher_deliverer, cleared_partner).
scene: A small orange ball (radius 18 mm) is thrown upwards and towards the left arm at t = 0. It rises high and falls back down near the left cup within about the first second. A blue open box (the cart: 0.15 m x 0.15 m inside, 0.06 m deep) is the moving link of a straight rail along the world's y axis, on the left arm's side. It is driven back and forth the whole episode, slowly, and slowest where it turns around. There are no other objects. The table top is the world's z = 0 plane.
scene_privileged: Ball: radius `radius` (0.018 m), mass `object_mass` (0.035 kg), restitution `restitution` (0.1), friction 0.2. At t = 0 it is at (0.03 + `incoming_speed` x `preview`, y0, 0.39) = (0.2575, y0, 0.39) with velocity (-`incoming_speed`, 0, (0.22 + 0.028 + `radius` - 0.39 + 4.905 x `preview`^2) / `preview`) = (-0.35, 0, about 2.998) m/s. It peaks at about z = 0.85 m (t of about 0.31 s) and passes through (0.03, y0, 0.248 + `radius`) = (0.03, y0, 0.266) at t = `preview` (0.65 s). y0 ~ U(-0.11, -0.07) is drawn at reset (first draw). Cart: moving link of a prismatic fixture whose rail origin is (-0.10, -0.29, 0.05), axis +y, limits +-0.5 m. It is an open box (inner half 0.075, walls 0.06 m) whose floor's top surface is the link origin (z = 0.05), mass 0.3 kg. At reset it is placed at q0 ~ U(-0.02, 0.02) (second draw) with velocity `fixture_speed`. It is then driven (PD, kp 80, kd 8, at most 8 N) to the target q0 + 0.20 sin((`fixture_speed`/0.20) t), with target velocity `fixture_speed` cos((`fixture_speed`/0.20) t). That is an oscillation of 0.20 m amplitude with peak speed `fixture_speed` (0.04 m/s) and period 31.4 s. It reverses at t = 7.85 s and t = 23.6 s, and its speed exceeds 0.02 m/s only for t < 5.2 s and 10.5 s < t < 20.9 s within the 25 s horizon (confirmed in an idle run). Cups: `tool_half` 0.06, `tool_height` 0.028, `tool_mass` 0.2 kg, `tool_friction` 0.3, restitution 0.05. Table friction `table_friction` (0.08). The right cup's start position (0.19, 0.18, 0.22) is stored as `right_start` and used by right_catch.

phases.name: left_initial_catch
phases.text: panda-0's cup catches the ball. First the ball flies free (touching nothing) for at least 25 ms. It then enters the cup from above: its centre crosses downwards through the plane `tool_height` + `radius` = 0.046 m above the cup floor (cup frame) while within `tool_half` - `radius` = 0.042 m of the cup centre in both x and y of the cup frame. After that entry the ball stays in the cup for 0.18 s without interruption. In the cup frame: |x| and |y| < `tool_half` - 0.45 x `radius` = 0.0519 m; centre between `radius` - 4 mm = 0.014 m and `tool_height` - 0.12 x `radius` = 0.02584 m above the floor; touched by that cup within the last 25 ms; speed relative to the cup < 0.09 m/s.

phases.name: left_to_right_flight
phases.text: The ball has touched nothing for more than 0.045 s (counted within this phase) and its centre is above z = 0.30 m.

phases.name: right_catch
phases.text: panda-1's cup catches the ball by the same test as left_initial_catch (a fresh entry from above after at least 25 ms of free flight, then retention for 0.18 s without interruption). At a step where this catch holds, the right cup's tool frame is more than 0.04 m (3-D distance) from its start position (0.19, 0.18, 0.22).

phases.name: second_region
phases.text: panda-1's tool frame is within 0.035 m of (0.13, 0.15, 0.24) while the ball is retained in the right cup. Retention uses the same test as above but needs no hold time.

phases.name: right_to_left_flight
phases.text: The ball has touched nothing for more than 0.045 s (counted within this phase) and its centre is above z = 0.31 m.

phases.name: left_catch_and_deliver
phases.text: panda-0's cup first catches the ball again (fresh entry from above after at least 25 ms of free flight, then retention for 0.18 s, as in left_initial_catch). After that catch is registered, the ball rests in the cart. In the cart's frame: |x| and |y| < 0.075 - 0.45 x `radius` = 0.0669 m; centre between 0.014 m and 0.06 - 0.12 x `radius` = 0.05784 m above the cart floor; touched by the cart within the last 25 ms; speed relative to the cart < 0.09 m/s. At the same time the ball does not touch the left cup and the cart moves faster than 0.02 m/s, for 0.7 s without interruption. This completes the task.

contact_rules: Each cup may touch only the ball. Neither cup may touch the cart, its rail or base, or the table. The two arms must never touch each other: any contact between any parts of panda-0 and panda-1, cups included, is a failure. No other robot part (fingers, hands, links, bases) may touch anything, including the ball.
world_goals_fixed: Second transfer region: the point (0.13, 0.15, 0.24) for panda-1's tool frame, radius 0.035 m. Flight heights: ball centre above z = 0.30 m (left to right) and z = 0.31 m (right to left). Right-cup relocation: more than 0.04 m from its start (0.19, 0.18, 0.22) at the right catch.
world_goals_seeded: `goal_target` = (0.03, y0, 0.22), the point under the ball's first crossing point, is announced at reset. It reveals the ball's seeded y0, so it is privileged mode only. Further flags (`transfer_a`, `transfer_b`, `left_start`, `right_start`) are stored but not exported as goal_* observations; transfer_a and transfer_b are not used by any predicate.
difficulty_note: Three catches in shallow 28 mm cups, two of them of a ball thrown by the other arm. Both throws must be real flights, and the two arms must never touch while working in a shared space. The final release must land in an oscillating box during one of its fast stretches.
standard_notes: The ball is already in the air at t = 0 and comes down within about the first second, so watch it in short steps. The cart moves back and forth the whole time and is too slow for the last phase near its turning points, so when the delivery can succeed depends on how long the earlier phases took.
